Alex: Quick question — we keep seeing p99 blow up when mixed interactive (50–300tok) + bulk (2k–5k) hit the same worker. Ideas for queueing handoff that keeps interactive latency tight without starving background?
Maria: My gut: soft isolation with a fast lane and a background lane. Reserve token budget for fast lane but allow borrow when idle. keeps util high.
Kevin: Token reserve helps but doesn't solve long-seq inside a fast batch. Need length-aware admission so long seqs get admitted into background even if they squeeze into fast lane.
Alex: Yeah, we had cases where a 3k request joined a fast cohort and nuked the whole batch. How do we detect early?
Maria: admission-time heuristic: check requested_max_tokens and recent seq-length histogram. If estimated batch tail > threshold -> route to background. lightweight check, no model warmup.
Kevin: Also add cohort caps: "max-cohort-length" and "cohort-count". If a large request lands, cap its contribution or force it to its own batch. Pseudocode: 
```
if req.length > lane.max_seq_length: route(background)
elif lane.estimated_tail + req.length > lane.tail_budget: route(background)
else admit(fast)
```
Jia: Important: what telemetry do we emit to validate? p50/p95/p99 by lane, fraction of cross-routed requests, queueing_delay histogram, batch-size distribution, and KV cache hit-rate per lane.
Alex: rollout plan: feature-flag traffic split + canary. Start with 5% traffic on mixed workloads, watch p99_fast and p99_background.
Maria: config example for ops: 
```
queues:
  - name: fast-lane
    reserved_tokens_pct: "15"
    max_seq_length: "512"
    preemptible: "true"
  - name: background
    reserved_tokens_pct: "85"
    max_seq_length: "8192"
```
Kevin: Edge-case: burst of short-heavy background jobs can exhaust reserved tokens. Need borrow/backfill policy: allow background to borrow but charge latency debt and throttle borrow rate.
Alex: Sounds good. Also want an escape hatch: if fast-lane p99 exceeds SLO, turn on strict mode where only <256 tokens allowed.
Jia: For evaluation, let's create a synthetic mix job: 70% interactive (mean 120), 30% bulk (mean 2500). Run loadgen and capture lane metrics + cross-route rate.
Kevin: One more: early-ack for background to speed client perceived latency for batchable ops. But be careful with KV cache semantics — early-ack should preserve correctness.
Maria: Agreed. We should document semantics: early-ack = client gets 202; actual response via callback/webhook. Only for idempotent batch ops.
Alex: Can we add a short-term simulation before deploying? simple event-driven sim that models cohorts, arrival dist, seq-length, and kernel time. Should be quick to write.
Kevin: I'll hack a sim in the next day. If anyone wants to pair pls ping.
Jia: I'll draft the telemetry dashboard fields and alert runbook.
ops-bot: deploybot: Canary feature-flag created: feature:lane_isolation_v2 -> enabled=false.
Alex: thx — I'll open a follow-up RFC with config knobs and rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
